title: festuca rubra var. multiflora
intro: Festuca rubra var. multiflora, commonly known as Red Fescue, is a type of grass species that belongs to the Poaceae family. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Red Fescue are attributed to its ability to promote tissue repair, reduce pain and inflammation, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects. The bioactive constituents of Red Fescue include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
